Screen Broadcast
Powers the translation window over other apps. Only the translator sees your screen
Asked each session
Android lets you share a single app instead of the whole screen — pick the game or the reader, and the system hands over nothing else. We don’t record, store or send anything. Text is recognized on the fly and discarded.
iOS shows a system Broadcast sheet each time the translation window starts. We don’t save the broadcast. Recognized text is discarded after translation.
Notifications that arrive during a session land in the capture too. Turn on Focus if you don’t want them read.

Siri Shortcuts

A fallback for when the translation window isn’t running: double-tap the floating AssistiveTouch button and the screen gets translated. Setup takes a few minutes — it lives deep in iOS Settings.

Live Screen Translator

Screenshot → translation. Works from any app.

Translate what you copied

You run it yourself, so iOS allows the paste. Background clipboard watching is not offered — the system does not permit it.

9:41
How it works
Translate with a double tap
This one is a long setup — about 8 screens deep in iOS Settings, and we can’t do it for you. If you just want to read manga or play, the translation window is one tap away.
Here, in the app
1
Add the shortcut
Opens the Shortcuts app → tap “Add Shortcut”.
Then, in iPhone Settings
2
Turn on AssistiveTouch
It puts a small floating button on your screen — the closest thing iOS has to a translate bubble.
Settings → Accessibility → Touch → AssistiveTouch → On
3
Bind it to a double tap
In the same screen, scroll to Custom Actions.
Custom Actions → Double-Tap → Live Screen Translator
4
Done — double-tap the floating button
Works in any app: a screenshot is taken, translated, and shown back to you.

Help & support
Common questions
The system asks for screen access every timeThat is the system, not the app: since Android 14 and on every iOS broadcast, capture is confirmed per session.
Sound effects stay untranslatedBy default the artwork is left as drawn. Turn on “Translate sound effects” to get a small caption beside them.
The translation does not fit the bubbleThe text shrinks while it stays readable; past that the bubble grows to hold the line.
Get in touch
Report a translation issue
Email support
A report sends the text you saw and the language pair — never the screen itself.
